subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: Which Feishu direct-message session-continuity policy should OpenClaw use for maintenance retention, malformed open_id handling, and existing session-history repair?
rationale: The source-backed bug is real, but the durable-session fix changes retention behavior and may require Feishu-specific validation plus upgrade repair, which automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: TTL-Aware Retention And Repair
options.body: Protect recent direct-message sessions from pruning/capping, add Feishu open_id validation or malformed-key detection, and provide doctor repair for affected history.

options.title: Feishu-Only Key Validation First
options.body: Keep generic direct-DM maintenance unchanged for now and first repair only malformed Feishu direct-session key creation and diagnostics.

options.title: Document Workaround Only
options.body: Treat `per-account-channel-peer` plus larger maintenance limits as the supported mitigation until live proof narrows the remaining malformed-key source.

recommendation.title: TTL-Aware Retention And Repair
recommendation.body: Protect recent direct-message sessions from pruning/capping, add Feishu open_id validation or malformed-key detection, and provide doctor repair for affected history.

likelyOwner.reason: The central unresolved decision crosses the session maintenance code path they recently split and the durable-session policy that current runtime uses.
